title: The question form refuses a command line that ends in a backslash after git, gh or npm
why: A command block line ending `origin\` passes today, so the owner gets a block that breaks when pasted.
note: Filed 09:23 CST Nov 8 from lane notes-fix-page (review note 49, measured by #2074's round-1 reviewer on main e2703c611). hooks/question_form.py:407; #1785 at ad6274e3d pins it as passing (test_question_form.py:1110-1112). Fix: refuse a backslash line end only after git, gh or npm; `cd C:\repo\` keeps passing. Red case first.
